d:
Bengluru ki ivenjlin gres har roz charch strit par apna polroid kaimra lekar aati hain. ivenjlin ke sath unki 10 mahine ki bachchi bhi hoti hai. ivenjlis gres logon ki polroid tasviren nikalti hain.
Mobail fon aur ek klik men tasviren lene ke daur men bengluru ki sarkon par polroid kaimra dikhna thora ajib lag sakta hai, lekin bharat sahit duniya bhar men polroid tasviron ka chalan barh raha hai. khaskar mileniyals aur jen zi ise kaphi pasand kar rahe hain.
